faq.q: What is the origin of Tamara?

No — the underlying form is Hebrew, not Arabic.
Tamara can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Hebrew-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Tamara, tamara. Script forms are تامارا, تَامَارَا, तमारा.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
